title: UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.19690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits

translated_title: UniExo：用于肌肉骨骼运动与协同自适应外骨骼控制的统一多技能策略
translated_abstract: 日常行走包含多种多样的活动以及活动之间频繁的转换，然而大多数外骨骼控制器都是为单一活动或一组狭窄的相关动作而设计的。因此，活动变化通常需要显式的模式切换以及单独调整或重新训练的控制器。基于仿真的学习减少了基于硬件调整的需求，但通常仍保留这一局限性。在此，我们提出了UniExo，一个首先构建多技能肌肉骨骼人体策略、然后与之共同训练外骨骼控制策略的框架。针对行走、转身、跑步和倒走这四种技能的单技能模仿专家被蒸馏到一个由技能潜变量构建的单一网络中，随后通过强化学习在过渡序列上进行微调。由此得到的统一人体策略在四种技能的未见片段上实现了94.7%的平均跟踪成功率，并且表现……
tldr: UniExo提出将行走、转身、跑步和倒走四种运动技能蒸馏为统一的肌肉骨骼人体策略，并与外骨骼控制策略协同训练，无需显式模式切换即可应对多样化的日常行走活动及其转换，跟踪成功率达94.7%。
en_tdlr: UniExo distills four locomotion skills (walking, turning, running, and backward walking) into a unified musculoskeletal human policy co-trained with an exoskeleton controller, enabling diverse daily locomotion and transitions without explicit mode switching, achieving 94.7% tracking success.
